source.description: Dark desktop code workspace with a narrow navigation rail, repository explorer, tabbed editor, and warm ambient backdrop.

typography.code: 'SF Mono', 'JetBrains Mono', Menlo, Monaco, Consolas, monospace

ui.purpose: Navigation, labels, project names, account metadata, and window controls.

code.purpose: Source code, file paths, line numbers, breadcrumbs, tabs, and status metadata.

window-shell.description: Floating desktop window with warm dark chrome, clipped 12px corners, and a soft black shadow.

traffic-lights.description: Three compact macOS window controls in red, yellow, and green.

top-chrome.description: Minimal header with centered Chats / Collab / Code segmented switch and a utility control.

navigation-rail.description: Left rail containing primary actions, recent prompts, and a compact user footer.

nav-item.description: Quiet icon-and-label row with muted iconography and low-contrast hover fill.

recent-prompt.description: Two-line recent conversation item with bright title and truncated muted summary.

repository-tree.description: Dark file explorer with repository breadcrumb, folder rows, file rows, and selected-file highlight.

editor-tabs.description: Compact tab strip with active file tab and quieter neighboring tabs.

breadcrumbs.description: Monospace repository / src / file path line with the final segment emphasized in gold.

code-editor.description: Full-height source editor with aligned line numbers and syntax-colored TypeScript.

branch-badge.description: Small gold branch/status capsule in the upper-right editor chrome.

status-bar.description: Low-contrast bottom strip showing language, line count, encoding, and project status.

narrative.northStar: The Quiet Axiom Workbench: a dark, compact coding cockpit where syntax color and one restrained gold status accent carry hierarchy against almost-black surfaces.
narrative.overview: A precision desktop editor presented as a floating window. Navigation and repository structure sit in low-contrast rails while the source file owns the visual center.
keyCharacteristics: Warm black-brown desktop chrome creates a premium shell.
UI contrast is restrained; hierarchy comes from placement, type, and syntax color.
The editor is the dominant surface and owns the brightest colors.
Gold signals active project context rather than decoration.
Compact 6px controls and a single 12px outer window radius keep the interface precise.
disciplineRules: Use gold only for active project context, branch/status badges, and selected code-adjacent affordances.
Keep navigation and chrome quieter than source code.
Use UI sans for human-facing navigation and monospace for files, paths, code, and metadata.
Use thin hairline borders and one floating-window shadow; keep internal panels flat.
Do not apply syntax colors to ordinary interface copy.
